test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The government has announced a new policy.

options.text: A new policy has been announced by the government.
A new policy was announced by the government.
A new policy had been announced by the government.
A new policy is being announced by the government.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The government has announced a new policy." 
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a new policy" at the beginning. 
 
• Change the active verb form "has announced" to "has been announced" (present perfect passive). 
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the government." 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"A new policy has been announced by the government."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 2: **"A new policy was announced by the government." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive instead of present perfect passive). 
 
• **Option 3: **"A new policy had been announced by the government." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive). 
 
• **Option 4: **"A new policy is being announced by the government." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
